title: dt_recon
description: Performs DTI reconstruction from the raw DWI input files.

info_dump.description: Use info dump created by unpacksdcmdir or dcmunpack.
info_dump.title: Info Dump

ec_reference.description: Use specified time points as 0-based reference for eddy current correction.
ec_reference.title: EC Reference Time Points

no_reg_flag.description: Do not register to subject or resample to talairach.
no_reg_flag.title: No Registration Flag

register_file.description: Supply a register.lta file instead of registering.
register_file.title: Register File

no_tal_flag.description: Do not resample FA to talairach space.
no_tal_flag.title: No Talairach Flag

pca_analysis_flag.description: Run PCA/SVD analysis on eres (saves in pca-eres dir).
pca_analysis_flag.title: PCA Analysis Flag

mask_prune_threshold.description: Set threshold for masking (default is FLT_MIN).
mask_prune_threshold.title: Mask Prune Threshold

init_spm_flag.description: Initialize BBR with SPM instead of coreg (requires MATLAB).
init_spm_flag.title: Initialize with SPM Flag

init_fsl_flag.description: Initialize BBR with FSL instead of coreg.
init_fsl_flag.title: Initialize with FSL Flag

version_flag.description: Print version of this script and exit.
version_flag.title: Version Flag
